# Software Services Agreement — v2

**Effective Date:** January 1, 2024
**Parties:** Acme Corp ("Client") and TechSolutions Inc ("Provider")

---

## 1. Services

Provider agrees to deliver software development and maintenance services as outlined in
Schedule A attached hereto.

## 2. Term

This Agreement shall commence on January 1, 2024, and continue for a period of **eighteen
(18) months**, unless earlier terminated in accordance with Section 9.

## 3. Fees and Payment

3.1 Client shall pay Provider a monthly retainer of **$10,500** per month.

3.2 Invoices are due and payable within **45 days** of receipt.

3.3 Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of **2.0% per month**.

3.4 Client shall reimburse Provider for all pre-approved out-of-pocket expenses incurred
in connection with the services, within 30 days of receipt of an itemized expense report.

## 4. Intellectual Property

All work product, inventions, and deliverables created by Provider under this Agreement
shall be considered works made for hire and shall be the exclusive property of Client upon
full payment of all fees.

## 5. Confidentiality

Each party agrees to hold in strict confidence all Confidential Information received from
the other party and not to disclose such information to any third party without prior
written consent. This obligation shall survive termination of this Agreement for a period
of three (3) years.

## 6. Limitation of Liability

In no event shall either party be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or
consequential damages arising out of or related to this Agreement, even if advised of the
possibility of such damages.

Provider's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid by Client in the **six (6)
months** preceding the claim.

## 7. Warranties

Provider warrants that all services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike
manner consistent with industry standards.

## 8. Dispute Resolution

Prior to initiating any legal action, the parties agree to attempt to resolve any dispute
through good-faith negotiation for a period of not less than thirty (30) days.

## 9. Termination

Either party may terminate this Agreement upon **60 days** written notice to the other
party. Client may terminate immediately for cause if Provider materially breaches this
Agreement and fails to cure within 15 days of written notice.

## 10. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of **Delaware**.

## 11. Entire Agreement

This Agreement, together with all Schedules attached hereto, constitutes the entire
agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof.

---

*Signatures on file.*
